headline: Linn of Mercy Reawakens as Heavy Clashes Persist in Mooring
war_summary: Linn of Mercy has abruptly reawakened after hours of dormancy, logging five strategic base shifts over the past two hours amid bitter fighting around Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Mooring County remains the war's most violent cauldron, absorbing over three thousand combined casualties in two hours and recording three further base turnovers as forces clash across The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast. To the west, Callum's Cape has finally broken its territorial gridlock with fresh base transitions recorded, even as casualty rates taper slightly from earlier peaks. Conversely, Weathered Expanse has cooled markedly after its earlier morning flare-up, recording no base changes in the past two hours while leaving four positions demolished in no-man's-land. Secondary sectors remain subdued; Marban Hollow logged only isolated contact at Checkpoint Bua, while Dead Lands, Stlican Shelf, and Stonecradle report minimal tactical disruption despite localized skirmishing.
